name: Cecil Adjani
source:
Cecil is a recent foreign exchange student from France. She is something of a perfectionist, and refuses to accept or give anything less than her best. Due to her childhood experience in a Catholic orphanage, Cecil is very knowledgeable in many religious affairs, and can perform the spiritual services of a fully ordained nun.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175338/www.elizar.com/?p=30]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
